name: 07023 · Fanwood, NJ
findings: ZIP 07023 (Fanwood) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07023 (Fanwood) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 07023 (Fanwood) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 38% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 58% of all organizations here have no identified type.
